itemUsage.en: Newly joined Sniper Operator Orchid faces every trouble with composure.
itemUsage.zh: 新晋狙击干员梓兰，冷静地面对一切麻烦。

itemDesc.en: She earnestly explains that she merely changed into a new outfit and nothing else has changed. Do you believe her?
itemDesc.zh: 她很认真地解释，她只是换了身衣服，并没有什么其他的变化，你相信吗？

description.en: Fires 4 arrows with ATK equal to <@ba.vup>{atk_scale_1:0%}</>.\n<@ba.rem>Can store 1 charge; automatically triggers once when reaching maximum charges</>

description.en: Immediately <$ba.liftoff>Takes Off</> and fires 3 times at all targets in the area ahead, releasing 3, 4, and 5 arrows with ATK increased to <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_loop:0%}</> respectively; then lands and deals Physical damage equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_end:0%}</> of ATK to all enemies in a small area ahead.\n<@ba.rem>Can store 1 charge; triggers immediately once upon deployment</>
description.zh: 立刻<$ba.liftoff>起飞</>并对前方范围的所有目标射击3次，分别射出3、4、5支攻击力提升至<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_loop:0%}</>的箭矢；之后降落并对前方小范围内的所有敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_end:0%}</>的物理伤害\n<@ba.rem>可充能1次，部署后立即释放一次</>

description.en: Charges for <@ba.vup>3</> seconds, then fires a piercing arrow in a straight line that pushes all enemies in its path with <@ba.vup>Medium force</>; for every distance traveled, deals Physical damage equal to <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK and Arts damage equal to <@ba.vup>{atk_scale_magic:0%}</> of ATK to all surrounding enemies; arrow has infinite range.\n<@ba.rem>Can store 1 charge</>
description.zh: 蓄力<@ba.vup>3</>秒后射出直线飞行的贯穿箭矢，箭矢以<@ba.vup>中等力度</>推动每个经过的敌人，每飞行一段距离都会对周围所有敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害和攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale_magic:0%}</>的法术伤害，箭矢射程无限\n<@ba.rem>可充能1次</>

description.en:
Earthspirit arrived at the corner of the training grounds, where she had set up several targets reserved for her personal use—well, she had never actually forbidden anyone else from using them, but everyone assumed they were hers alone; after all, their shapes were far too distinct.
Earthspirit had just finished an excruciating debrief with Op Reserve Team A6. Catapult had gone off on her own again, Spot had submitted a report covered in storyboard drafts for his new manga, and Midnight had tried to smooth things over with a few bar coupons. She felt that familiar tide of irritation rushing over her.
Taking a deep breath, Earthspirit drew her bow.
To her, what she hunted was not beasts, but chaos.
Evidently, returning from the land of mirages hadn't changed her daily life in the slightest, nor could a momentary shift in perspective quench the fury ignited by reality.
Thwack. An arrow struck Spot's chest with pinpoint accuracy. She recalled that sloppy report and that guy's lazy face.
Thwack. An arrow pierced Midnight's collar. She recalled the pungent cologne and his smooth, empty excuses.
Thwack, thwack, thwack. She recalled Catapult's near-suicidal thrill in battle. Her breathing quickened as arrow after arrow flew out, until that target was bristling with shafts.
Then, her eyes landed on the final target. Popukar. Earthspirit drew her bow and took aim.
Popukar was always the child who gave her the biggest headache. Because Popukar stubbornly believed that Team A6 would stay together forever, a conviction that hadn't changed one bit as she grew older.
Sometimes, Popukar's unwavering certainty gave her a fleeting panic that she might be saddled with A6's headaches for the rest of her life.
Still, she stared at Popukar for a long time before taking a deep breath and calming down.
She had never done something like this in the past—she would just lose her temper directly. But she knew losing her temper changed nothing; these people wouldn't reform, and in the end, she had to bottle it all up herself.
Yet after returning from the land of mirages, she decided to try a new approach. To her surprise, none of the A6 members took offense; they even began teasing each other over whether Earthspirit had shot at their target that day. And for her, each shooting session brought a few fresh ideas.
She decided not to scold Spot, but to leave his report unreviewed for now, waiting until he couldn't stand it and came asking on his own.
She decided to pretend to believe Midnight's nonsense, just to see how he'd react if she actually followed his advice.
As for Catapult, well, she had to admit she didn't actually dislike who Catapult was now. If there was anything she could truly do, perhaps it was to hone her skills so she could stop Catapult from taking reckless risks in the future, or... help her? Earthspirit sighed, reluctant to admit she was having such thoughts.
And Popukar—alas, what could Popukar ever do wrong! She was already thinking about what design to use for Popukar's new outfit.
With those thoughts in mind, she happily lowered her bow.
Yes, with her frustration vented, she felt much lighter.
She began to realize that perhaps some things were never as complicated as she had once thought.
description.zh:
梓兰来到训练场的角落，她在这里竖起了几个她专用的靶子——好吧，她其实没说过别人不能用，但大家认为就是她专用的，毕竟，这些靶子的造型太过特别。
梓兰刚结束了一次令人头疼的A6任务复盘。空爆又擅自行动了，斑点提交的报告画满了他新漫画的分镜草稿，而月见夜则试图用几张酒吧优惠券来蒙混过关。她感到那种熟悉的心烦像潮水一样涌来。
梓兰深吸一口气，拉开了弓。
对她来说，她的狩猎对象，并不是野兽，而是混乱。
显而易见的是，从泡影国归来没有让她的生活发生任何改变，某个瞬间的心态变化也并不能平息现实带来的怒火。
唰。箭矢精准地钉在斑点的胸口。她想起了那份潦草的报告和那家伙懒洋洋的脸。
唰。箭矢戳破了月见夜的衣领。她想起了那股刺鼻的香水味和他那套敷衍的说辞。
唰、唰、唰。她想起了空爆在战斗中那近乎自毁的兴奋。她的呼吸变得急促，箭矢接二连三地飞出，直到那个靶子上插满了箭。
随后，她的视线落在最后一个靶子上。泡普卡。梓兰拉开弓，瞄准了它。
泡普卡一直是她最头疼的孩子。因为，泡普卡执拗地相信，A6必然会永远存在，这一点完全没有随着其年龄的增长发生任何改变。
有的时候，泡普卡的坚定会让她产生自己要被A6这些烦恼纠缠一辈子的恐慌感。
不过，她凝视了泡普卡许久，最终，深呼吸了一次，平静下来。
过去她从未做过这样的事——她会直接发脾气，但是，她知道自己发脾气没有用，这帮人并不会改，最终，她只能独自消化。
但从泡影国回来后，她决定尝试一下新方法，然后，她惊讶地发现，A6的队员们并没有对此有什么不满，他们甚至开始拿她今天有没有对彼此的靶子射箭来互相调侃。而对她来说，每次这么做之后，她的心中都会有一些想法。
她打算不去骂斑点，而是暂时搁置对他报告的评价，等他自己憋不住了来问。
她决定假装相信月见夜的鬼话，看看如果自己按照他说的去做，这家伙会有什么反应。
至于空爆，好吧，她必须承认，她其实并不讨厌现在的空爆，如果说自己真的能做些什么，那或许只有磨练技艺，以便在未来阻止她做危险的事，或者……帮助她？梓兰叹了口气，她实在不愿意承认自己在想这样的事。
而泡普卡，唉，泡普卡又能有什么错呢！她已经在想该给泡普卡的新衣服做什么设计了。
这么想着，她愉快地放下了弓箭。
是的，在怨气被发散出去后，她感觉自己也变得轻盈了。
她逐渐开始相信——有些事好像确实没有自己过去想的那么复杂。
